tagline: Find the roles worth your time.
teamInformation: Solo submission by Jewon Yeon. No additional team members.
shortDescription: JobPilot turns application fatigue into a transparent decision loop: discover nearby and Remote roles, prioritize three next decisions, understand evidence, open a synthetic employer destination, and track progress locally without auto-apply or hidden score adjustments.
inspiration: I built JobPilot because job search fatigue is decision fatigue: repeated searching, manual comparison, employer-link hunting, and disconnected tracking still leave a person unsure which application deserves the next hour.
whatItDoes: Connects Discover, Prioritize, Understand, Apply, and Track around a transparent three-role shortlist with explicit user control.
howItWorks: The public demo uses deterministic shortlist ordering, progressive Job Detail proof, a synthetic employer handoff, and browser-local tracking. It requires no login, API key, Ollama installation, or real resume.
howCodexWasUsed: Codex was used throughout development, debugging, repair, testing, release evidence, and the Build Week defect timeline.
howGpt56WasUsed: Four gpt-5.6-sol artifacts were prepared through Codex from frozen synthetic evidence: application strategy, independent challenge, ambiguity review, and comparison. They are not live runtime calls and cannot calculate or change Fit Score.
technicalArchitecture: Gemma 4 12B is the primary local semantic model. Deterministic AI Fit V2.2 owns every final score and Score Receipt. The web, API, and CLI verifier reproduces canonicalization, exact micro-point arithmetic, evidence/source hashes, and tamper failure.
nearbyDiscovery: Profile-configured city, distance, and work-mode preferences drive deterministic nearby and Remote labels without changing technical Fit Score.
resumeAwarePrioritization: The local edition parses a resume in memory, asks the user to confirm structured evidence, stores it browser-locally, and uses loopback gemma4:12b. The public deployment accepts no resume.
directEmployerDestination: Only an explicit verified trust state uses Apply on Employer Site. The synthetic public destination disables submission and never auto-marks Applied.
scoreReceiptVerifier: Web, API, and CLI surfaces independently reproduce canonicalization, exact micro-point arithmetic, evidence/source hashes, and tamper failure.
gemmaUse: Gemma 4 12B is the primary local semantic model for extraction, grouping, evidence matching, equivalence, summaries, and uncertainty. Public review uses cached prepared analysis.
zeroApiRuntime: 0 OpenAI API requests and $0 OpenAI API runtime cost.
whatILearned: Trust comes from progressive proof, explicit model boundaries, reproducible arithmetic, and disciplined claim limits.
directionalUsabilityEvidence: Five authentic, moderated participants completed jobpilot-decision-utility.v2. Five files were accepted, zero were rejected, ten human rows were analyzed, and no fabricated or dry-run row was counted. Median task time was 39 seconds with a traditional posting and 18 seconds with JobPilot; factual accuracy was 75% and 100%; confidence was 3.8 and 6.0 out of 7; clarity was 3.6 and 6.2 out of 7. All participants completed the traditional condition first and JobPilot second. Different roles prevented same-role carryover, but practice or order effects may contribute to the observed difference.
limitations: Public data is synthetic, coverage is processed-portfolio coverage only, Fit Score is not a hiring probability, and no hiring-outcome calibration is claimed. The n=5 usability evidence is directional and fixed-order. All participants completed the traditional condition first and JobPilot second. Different roles prevented same-role carryover, but practice or order effects may contribute to the observed difference.

buildWeekExtension: Added the no-login Golden Path, application-fatigue story, nearby discovery, transparent shortlist, private resume isolation, concise detail, comparison, safe handoff, tracker, receipt verifier, prepared GPT review surfaces, Trust Lab, coverage proof, and authentic Decision Utility workflow.
testingInstructions: Open the landing page, choose See My Best Matches, inspect Harbor Product Data Analyst, open Application Strategy and Score Proof, verify the bundled receipt to FULLY_REPRODUCED, tamper it to INVALID, visit Trust Lab, and inspect the browser-local Tracker.
